summary: Proposes using OAuth 2.0 to get and validate short-lived tokens for STUN authentication. Because the tokens are ephemeral, access to a STUN server can still be controlled even if a token is stolen.

eli5.summary: Instead of giving everyone a permanent key, you hand out a ticket that stops working soon. Even if a ticket is stolen, it is not much use.

questions: how to use oauth with stun
